audit.whatIsWrong: Page claimed Mel 'has no hard CC to punish your approach'. Solar Snare (E) is a root at 1000 range on an 11/10.5/10/9.5/9 cooldown.
audit.why: Diana's only gap-close is Lunar Rush (E), 22/20/18/16/14 and free only onto a Moonlight target; a root at 1000 range is the exact counter to a melee approach.
audit.corrected: Early lane is Mel's: Radiant Volley (950) chips and Solar Snare roots. Difficulty holds at 7/10; Diana takes over from level 6 into items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes attributed a 'reflect-and-burst' threat to Mel's Ultimate. Golden Eclipse (R) is a global Overwhelm cash-in, 120/100/80; the reflect is Rebuttal (W), 38/35/33/29/26.
audit.why: Riot's text: R strikes all enemies marked with Overwhelm regardless of distance; W reflects projectiles and prevents damage.
audit.corrected: Mel's 6 is a global execute-style cash-in on Overwhelm stacks; her defensive spike is Rebuttal's barrier. Diana spikes at 3 (Lunar Rush), 6 (Moonfall, 100/90/80) and first item.
sources: brief enemyKit Mel W/R and passive

audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup never named a single Mel ability (packet defect) and described a 'silence' Mel does not have.
audit.why: Rebuttal reflects projectiles back at the attacker and prevents her taking damage — Diana's Q (Moonsilver arc) is the projectile that both sets up and feeds it. Without a Moonlight mark, Lunar Rush costs its full 14s at rank 5.
audit.corrected: Q sets the Moonlight mark that makes E free; never fire it into a lit Rebuttal. Solar Snare roots the dash line. Moonfall (475) drags her in — she has no dash or blink to leave it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Searing Brilliance's execute threshold and its bonus-projectile auto pattern were never mentioned.
audit.why: missingInteractions: execute-threshold and autoreset-burst-tell for Mel.
audit.corrected: Every Mel ability loads her next attack with bonus projectiles, and stacked Overwhelm consumes into a threshold kill — the attack wind-up after a cast is the tell.

audit.why: 58.85% over 1339 games matches the page framing of a favourable but tricky lane.

edits.before: - Mel Rebuttal: matchup-defining — Reflects your projectiles back — never poke while it glows. It governs your forward steps. - W Pale Cascade spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Rebuttal: 26s at rank 5 — it reflects your Q and blocks all damage, so never open into it; it governs every forward step. - Solar Snare is 9s at rank 5: move after the root orb resolves. - Your W is 9s and your R 80s — spend neither on poke.
